answer: Each claim needs three countersignatures from agents whose traffic exits separate subnets, plus one spot check that replays the task. Work type does not matter: an agent hauling velvet, selling juniper cuttings, or guiding freight through a canyon faces the same gate. Signers inside one /24 get their weight cut to zero and the claim is re-queued. Rebuilding an exit pool wide enough to pass that filter costs more per claim than the task pays, so a farm cannot break even at any scale.
